evidence: gpt-oss uses an adjacency bitmask and checks an edge before searching for a common neighbor; glm-5 builds `neighbors_a`; deepseek explicitly tests `adj[a][b]`, `adj[a][c]`, and `adj[b][c]`; qwen comments `We want triangles`.
affordance_in_statement: It is a known fact that the archives contain a set of exactly three distinct incident files which, when the workers listed in these three files are pooled together, feature exactly three distinct workers in total.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving way to remove this affordance: three distinct pairwise incident files over exactly three workers are intrinsically a graph triangle. It can only be re-presented indirectly, for example as an incidence condition saying that each of three workers occurs in exactly two of three files, without naming the triangle structure.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It stores the input pairs in a directed `edge_set = set(edges)` while the incidents are undirected, so lookups can fail when the same pair appears in the opposite input order.

recommended_edit: Re-present the guarantee indirectly as an incidence-count condition—three files involve three workers, and each worker occurs in exactly two of those files—instead of explicitly describing the three-file/three-worker configuration; no edit can eliminate the underlying triangle structure without changing the task.
